name: Hakaliah (Nehemiah's father)
title: Father of Jerusalem's Rebuilder
summary: Hakaliah was the father of Nehemiah, who served as cupbearer to the Persian king Artaxerxes and later led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls. Although little is known about Hakaliah himself, he was the father of one of the most significant leaders in the post-Babylonian period.

keyEvents.title: Identified as Nehemiah's father
keyEvents.description: Hakaliah is mentioned at the beginning of the book of Nehemiah as the father of Nehemiah, the cupbearer who was called to rebuild Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in connection with the covenant renewal
keyEvents.description: In the list of those who sealed the covenant, Nehemiah son of Hakaliah is identified as governor and leader.
